epics.title: Deliver Missing API Slice D3a7a0f6
epics.jtbd: When deploying the API, I want all committed code to be present on main, so that the endpoint functions correctly.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce cross-project audit null coercion errors from current baseline to 0
requirements: R1: Fix SixSigmaAuditService.calculateFullSixSigmaAudit() to calculate cross-project audits without null coercion errors by calling calculateSixSigmaAuditInternal(null) directly instead of calculateProjectSixSigmaAudit(getActiveProjectId()).

slices.title: Fix SixSigmaAuditService null coercion in full audit
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to bypass project ID coercion for full audits, so that the endpoint functions correctly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a request to calculate a full Six Sigma audit
When the system executes calculateFullSixSigmaAudit()
Then it calls calculateSixSigmaAuditInternal(null) directly without coercing the active project ID
And unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify that no null coercion errors occur during cross-project calculations.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce cross-project audit null coercion errors to 0

epics.title: Fix AutoMergeService Runtime Contract GitHub PR Reconciliation
epics.jtbd: When the orchestrator automatically merges PRs, I want the system to accurately match the PR to its task even if the session PR URL is null, so that successfully delivered work is correctly recorded as merged.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce missed PR reconciliations from current baseline to 0
requirements: R1: Fix AutoMergeService.reconcileMergedGitHubPullRequests() to accurately reconcile merged PRs to tasks even when session.getPrUrl() is null or empty.

slices.title: Fix PR reconciliation for null session PR URLs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to match PRs accurately without relying solely on the session PR URL, so that successfully delivered work is correctly recorded as merged.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a successfully merged PR where the orchestrator session's PR URL is null
When AutoMergeService.reconcileMergedGitHubPullRequests() runs
Then it accurately matches the PR to its corresponding task
And unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify that PR reconciliation succeeds even when session.getPrUrl() is missing.

epics.title: Measurement (GQM) for Missing Delivered Work
epics.jtbd: When operating the system, I want to measure the error rates of restored logic (Question 1: Are cross-project audits calculating without null coercion errors? Question 2: Are merged PRs correctly reconciled to tasks?), so that I know the previously missing logic is fully operational.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% telemetry coverage for cross-project audits and PR reconciliations
epics.tocConstraintRef: Telemetry visibility on missing delivered logic
requirements: R1: Measure if cross-project audits are calculating without null coercion errors.
R2: Measure if merged PRs are correctly reconciled to tasks.

slices.title: Implement GQM metrics for cross-project audits
slices.jtbd: When implementing GQM for this epic, I want to track null coercion errors, so that I know the cross-project audit calculation logic is operational.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a full Six Sigma audit calculation
When the calculation completes or fails
Then the telemetry system records a metric tracking whether a null coercion error occurred
And unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the metric is correctly recorded.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% telemetry coverage for cross-project audit calculations

slices.title: Implement GQM metrics for PR reconciliation
slices.jtbd: When implementing GQM for this epic, I want to track successful PR matches, so that I know the PR reconciliation logic is operational.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the AutoMergeService reconciliation scanner
When a PR is processed
Then the telemetry system records a metric indicating whether it successfully reconciled to a task
And unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the metric is accurately incremented.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Telemetry visibility on PR merge reconciliation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% telemetry coverage for PR reconciliation attempts
